label: Readiness steps for the phone app (docs/app-spec.md §2.5, §2.8)
rules: A step shows a cost or a time only when it has a source_url. web/lib/app/readiness.ts drops cost_stated/time_stated otherwise.
flag: verified = a primary or official source was checked; inferred = our reading of vendor/secondary material or a primary text; assumption = not sourced.
No invented costs. AS9100 and ISO 9001 show steps only; consultant estimates are INFERRED and not shown.

CWB_W47.1.title: CSA W47.1 company certification
CWB_W47.1.summary: W47.1 certifies the company, not a person. CWB checks the shop's supervisor, procedures, engineering and every production welder, then audits it to keep the certification current.

steps.label: A qualified welding supervisor
steps.detail: Name at least one welding supervisor who has passed the CWB written and verbal exams.

steps.label: Approved welding procedures (WPS)
steps.detail: Write a welding procedure specification for each welding process you use and have CWB accept it.

steps.label: An engineer, depending on division
steps.detail: Division 1: a full-time engineer on staff. Division 2: a retained engineer. Division 3: no engineer required.

steps.label: Every production welder tested
steps.detail: Each welder is tested for the processes and positions used in production (FW/S/T tickets). This is the step a prime-funded training package can pay for.

steps.label: Periodic CWB audits
steps.detail: CWB audits the company periodically to keep the certification current. Primes check the CWB certified-company directory, not a wall certificate.

steps.label: Dates and fees
steps.detail: Test centres set their own dates and fees. Muster does not show a cost or a schedule for this certification; ask CWB or your test centre.

CGP.title: Controlled Goods Program registration
CGP.summary: Registration lets a shop examine, possess or transfer controlled goods, including technical data. Muster never stores drawings; the prime releases them through its own channel.

steps.label: Appoint a designated official
steps.detail: Name the person responsible for the program at your company. They go through a security assessment.

steps.label: Write a security plan
steps.detail: Describe how you control access to controlled goods and technical data at your site.

steps.label: Apply to register
steps.detail: Submit a complete application to the Controlled Goods Program.
steps.time_stated: Up to 32 business days for complete applications

steps.label: Keep it current
steps.detail: Registration lasts up to 5 years. File renewal at least 90 days before it expires; if it lapses you must register again from scratch.
steps.time_stated: Renew at least 90 days before expiry

CPCSC_L1.title: CPCSC Level 1 (cyber security)
CPCSC_L1.summary: An annual self-assessment against 13 security controls. There is no public registry, so in Muster it is always shop-declared.

steps.label: Complete the self-assessment
steps.detail: Assess your company against the 13 Level 1 controls using the official tool, linked from the government announcement.

steps.label: Record it as shop-declared
steps.detail: Add the date in your Certs tab. It reads "shop-declared", never "verified", because there is no registry to check.

AS9100.title: AS9100 quality management
AS9100.summary: An aerospace and defence quality system built on ISO 9001, certified by an accredited registrar. Muster shows no cost figures for it.

steps.label: Build the quality system
steps.detail: Document and run a quality management system that meets AS9100 (ISO 9001 plus aerospace and defence requirements).

steps.label: Certification audit
steps.detail: An accredited certification body (registrar) audits the system and issues the certificate.

steps.label: Surveillance audits
steps.detail: The certificate lasts up to 3 years, with a surveillance audit every year.

ISO9001.title: ISO 9001 quality management
ISO9001.summary: A general quality management system, certified by an accredited certification body. Muster shows no cost figures for it.

steps.label: Build the quality system
steps.detail: Document and run a quality management system that meets ISO 9001.

steps.label: Certification audit
steps.detail: An accredited certification body audits the system. Primes can look the certificate up on IAF CertSearch.

steps.label: Surveillance audits
steps.detail: A 3-year certification cycle with yearly surveillance audits (assumption: the same cycle as AS9100).

NADCAP.title: Nadcap special-process accreditation
NADCAP.summary: Accreditation for one special process (heat treat, chemical processing, coatings), run by PRI. Muster does not compute merit tiers or costs.

steps.label: Self-audit for the process
steps.detail: Complete the Nadcap self-audit checklist for the commodity your jobs need.

steps.label: On-site audit
steps.detail: A PRI auditor audits the process on site; you close any findings.

steps.label: Read the expiry off the certificate
steps.detail: Accreditation length is printed on the certificate (typically 12 to 24 months).

process_default.title: More hours or a new process
process_default.summary: The jobs need more free hours (or a process you don't run yet). These steps are suggestions, not rules.

steps.label: Confirm your real free hours
steps.detail: Tell Northgate how many hours you can staff for the next 4 weeks.

steps.label: Add trained workers
steps.detail: Sponsor apprentices or train workers for the process. A prime-funded training package can pay for this.

other_funding.name: Canada-Ontario Job Grant
other_funding.text: Up to $10K per trainee; employers under 100 staff pay at least 1/6. Verify eligibility; stacking with prime funding not confirmed.

welder_ticket.text: Valid 2 years while continuously employed by a CWB-certified company. Check test from 90 days before to 90 days after expiry; after that, a full retest. May lapse after 3 months without using the process (confirm on the welder's card).
welder_ticket.note: The 3-month non-use rule is INFERRED from card text. Same text as the CWB_WELDER_TICKET row in data/rules/renewals.json (Agent C).

seat_stages.label: Nominated
seat_stages.detail: Your shop put you forward for a funded seat.

seat_stages.label: Eligibility attested
seat_stages.detail: Your shop records a yes/no attestation only.

seat_stages.label: Enrolled
seat_stages.detail: You have a seat with the training provider.

seat_stages.label: Training started
seat_stages.detail: Classes and shop practice are under way.

seat_stages.label: Test booked
seat_stages.detail: Your CWB test date is set.

seat_stages.label: Test passed
seat_stages.detail: You passed the test for your process and position.

seat_stages.label: Ticket issued
seat_stages.detail: Your CWB ticket is issued and your shop can put you on the jobs.

seat_demo.note: Demo simulation: funding a package puts every seat at "enrolled"; the example test date is the funding date plus 6 weeks.
